auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to non-provision of interest on NPA account of Asset Reconstruction Company of Rs.149.61 Crore for the year and Rs.1066.12 Crore cumulative; Emphasis of Matter on non-payment of instalments/interest, redemption of preference shares pending NCLT approval, pending litigation/enquiries, and confirmation/reconciliation of certain accounts.

key_risks: Non-provision of interest on NPA account of ARC leading to understatement of loss and liability
Pending litigation, enquiries, notices, summons, recovery and fraud proceedings against the Company and Directors
Non-payment of instalments and interest due, with risk of restoration of loan amount to original amount on default
Redemption of non-cumulative redeemable preference shares pending NCLT approval
Confirmation/reconciliation pending for trade receivables, trade payables, advances from customers, advances recoverable, and advances to suppliers
